title: Community, Environment, and Development, B.S. — Community and Economic Development Option (College of Agricultural Sciences)
notes: Fetched the raw archived 2022-23 bulletin HTML at the source URL below. Same Third Year / Fourth Year course list as the 2023-24 edition (PLSC 1/3/14 in Third Year Fall, CED 327 in Third Year Spring -- see CED-2023.json's own notes for that swap relative to 2024-2026), but with two real, confirmed Second Year differences that are NOT present in any later edition: (1) CED 275 (1cr) sits in Second Year Fall here, not First Year Spring as in every 2023-2026 edition -- First Year Spring this year has no CED 275 at all (confirmed: this edition's own printed First Year Spring subtotal is 15-16cr vs. 2023-2026's 16-17cr, exactly the missing 1cr); AGBM 106/CMPSC 203 is likewise in Second Year Fall here (not Spring); and STAT 200 is in Second Year Spring here (not Fall). (2) 'CED 252' does not appear anywhere on this edition's page at all (confirmed zero matches in the raw HTML) -- the real 2022-23 Second Year Spring requirement in its place is 'SOC 23' (Population and Policy Issues, a real, already-cataloged course with no prereqs of its own), confirmed by direct inspection of the fetched table row. This is a genuine curriculum change: CED 252 was evidently introduced as a Community and Economic Development Option requirement sometime between the 2022-23 and 2023-24 editions, replacing the older SOC 23 requirement. Also lists 'CAS 100' (unsectioned) as a fourth alternative to CAS 100A/100B/100C, same as 2023-24 (see that file's notes for the workaround convention). Reproduced the same shared-catalog hidden-prereq fixes as the other CED files (AEE 360 before AEE 460 in Semester 5/6; MATH 3 -> MATH 4 -> MATH 21 before STAT 200 in Semesters 1-3, with MATH 21 landing in Semester 3, safely before this edition's own Semester-4 placement of STAT 200) since these come from the shared, year-invariant course catalog, not from bulletin text.
